change_summary: Changed grid from hardcoded `(triton.cdiv(xnumel, 128),)` to `lambda meta: (triton.cdiv(xnumel, meta['XBLOCK']),)` so the autotuner's selected XBLOCK actually controls the launch grid, and added tl.max_contiguous + tl.multiple_of hints to r0_index to enable 128-bit vectorized LDG.128 loads on the stride-1 reduction dimension.
